Maria (CS): Drafting a short SMB 'starter handshake' runbook for AEs — low-touch onboarding + predictable perf + renewal signals. Posting draft checklist, pls quick review.

Devon (SE): 👍 include a tiny client prefill example and a stream-first fallback snippet. SMBs like low-latency UX.

Maria (CS): Draft checklist below. Keeping it compact for AE one-pager.

Maria (CS): RUNBOOK (SMB starter handshake)
- 0) Preflight: AE asks customer for sample QPS and region.
- 1) Client prefill (reduce tokens): example payload: ```json
{
  "customer_id": "ACME-123",
  "prefill": "last_issue_summaries",
  "prompt": "Summarize recent tickets for user X"
}
```
- 2) Batching defaults (SMB): max_batch_size=8, max_batch_latency_ms=40, per-client concurrency=4. Reason: typical small pool keeps p95 < 400ms.
- 3) Stream-first behavior: prefer streaming; recommended first-token timeout=3s (client-configurable). If first token not received, fallback to non-stream request with fast_mode=true.
- 4) Cache: static prompt fragments cached 24h; emit X-Cache-Hit in telemetry.
- 5) Model routing & safe fallback: route to optimized variant, fallback to quantized cheaper variant for non-critical routes; include X-Model-Variant header.
- 6) Renewal signals & micro-survey: track feature usage, token trend, success rate. Flag renewal risk if tokens decline 14d and usage < 2x baseline. Send 1-question pulse after 7d: "Was this helpful? Yes/No". Webhook event: cs_pulse_response.
- 7) Triage & escalation: heuristic: if >3 429s in 10m escalate to CS; create ticket if AE inactive 48h.

Devon (SE): snippet for stream-first fallback (pseudo): ```js
const stream = await client.stream('/chat', {onFirstTokenTimeout: 3000});
if (!stream.firstToken) await client.request('/chat', {body, fast_mode: true});
```

Sam (Platform): add observability headers: X-Cache-Hit, X-Batch-Size, X-Model-Variant, X-Stream-Fallback. Recommend Retry-After on 429 and jittered backoff (base 500ms).

Jenna (PM): AE one-liner: "If >3 429s in 10m or p95 latency >1s escalate to CS + open runbook." Also adding a tiny decision tree: stream ? batch : non-stream for common ask patterns.

onboard-bot: Reminder: publish SMB starter-handshake AE one-pager in /customer-playbooks within 48h ✅

Maria (CS): I'll update internal doc, make AE slide, and wire the webhook schema. Tagging @Devon and @Sam for tech review. Any blockers?

Devon (SE): none, can review webhook tomorrow morning.

Sam (Platform): fine, will add headers to tracing template.
